Issue Number: close #57085 

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

Code to provide a minimum cost to table scan - should use "max" rather than "min" to ensure that the minimum is actually applied. Current code will produce a lower cost for tablescans greater than 1000 rows that fit the other criteria for requiring a minimum cost to table scans.

issue_context.title: Planner: Test TestCostModelVer2ScanRowSize tablescan row size is incorrect

review_comments: Why do we need to change this?

The goal of the "hasLowEstimate" check is based upon a customer scenario where it was observed that the tablescan estimate used the ModifyCount - which was lower than the RealtimeCount. It was observed in explain, but there was no plan replayer so we could not reproduce the issue. In recent testing - I discovered that the ModifyCount can equal RealtimeCount. That meant that this boolean could be incorrectly set. Therefore - I changed the check to use ModifyCount < RealtimeCount to avoid that situation.
May I ask why we need to remove this index?

These tests are to test the realtime stats values. The presence of the index can result in the plan flipping to use an index for some of the tests - since stats are pseudo. Since the test is to demonstrate the realtime stats value and not to test the plan choice, I removed the index so that the plans do not change. Otherwise we need an "ignore index" on the queries to ensure that we keep a tablescan so that the actual realtime stats values can be observed for the test.
